what: Sixteen Advanced Temporary Fencing hire agreements 36601-36616, installed 12 to 15 Oct 2026, signed by Andrew on 16 Oct 2026 and photographed; recorded through the page's own red-book form (recordHireAgreement) and charged at the 2026 card by the page's own rules. Mesh fence metres go on the clean line; a paper that says braced and scrimmed carries scrim for the same metres (the clean-plus-scrim convention); CC barrier goes to demarcation where the paper's notes say demarcation, and to demarcation marked to confirm where the paper says only CC barrier (as 36559 and 36560 stand); flat-feet CCB on its own line; pedestrian gates each. Wheels, bases, clamps and braces are components on the paper, not charge lines.
